angleRead.name: Tanya Cruz
angleRead.text: The clubhouse is quiet in a way it never is in October. I stand near the empty stalls and think about how a season ends and another one starts before anyone has caught their breath. Mike Paulson's name is on everyone's lips but he isn't here, and that absence is the story. I want to watch how the room fills back up, who lingers, who leaves early. The off-season is a waiting game and I am good at waiting.

unverifiedLead: A sense that the clubhouse is quieter than usual for this time of year, as if everyone is waiting for something.
